text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I won! I finished first!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And the whole crowd was watching—watching me run, not just stand there looking pretty.

text_block_list.name: Gold City

君ならもっと上を目指せる！

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
My true skill! Damn, okay, I like the
sound of
that. Like I have all this hidden
potential or
something.
choice_data_list: 貴方の“実力”が示せたね！
君ならもっと上を目指せる！
貴方ならもっと上を目指せる！

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm so confused. Somehow I'm,
like, more
excited than I was before the
race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, when's the next one? I
wanna run
more and more.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I want to run and win, and let everyone
know that
I'm not just some pretty doll!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What? You're not going to compliment
me first?
Would it hurt to let me enjoy
this victory?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But I'm still smiling. I can do even
better,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It actually makes me really happy to hear you say that. I mean, my manager tells me the same thing, but you believe in my strength.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I can't let you down now, can I?
All right,
starting tomorrow, no more
going easy on me!
